page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.large is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. Operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, this instance features 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core with hyper-threading enabled. It is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on external storage solutions.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The processor achieves average single-core performance, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1350.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1572.49. However, multi-core and memory-intensive benchmarks are generally poor, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 1615.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 2536.99. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, registering at 16.29 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 14.38 GB/sec for write operations.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation but limited core count and memory bandwidth, this instance represents a cost-efficient entry point for workloads that require predictable CPU access without massive parallel processing demands. It is suited for lightweight single-threaded tasks, basic text processing, development environments, and low-traffic web serving. It is less optimal for database operations, heavy compilation, or memory-bound applications due to its lower multi-core efficiency and weak memory performance.
